answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the committed src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. Regenerating from the API produces a diff in CatalogHistoryOutput.catalog_history_action (a union type reformatted across multiple lines), and the job exits 1 on that mismatch. The diff is deterministic for this commit, so a re-run will fail the same way. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api in openaev-front and commit the updated api-types.d.ts.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
